original_query: Sahaja Aharam links farmers to whom?

summaries.summary: The slide explains Sahaja Aharam as an F2C initiative that links nature-friendly farmers with consumers by blending traditional bazaars with ecological concerns. It aims to build a new supply chain through direct retailing and partnerships, increasing farmers' income and providing consumers with healthy, diverse food.
key_facts: Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative linking farmers and consumers.
It blends traditional bazaars with ecological concerns.
It increases farmers' income by 50% over cost of production and 50% of consumer price through ecological farming.
It provides more employment opportunities through value addition and processed produce.
It offers consumers access to healthy and diverse food.
It uses a Participatory Food Quality Assurance System and Fair Trade Model.
It operates through direct retailing to consumers (bulk/individual) and partnerships.
